articles.title: Supreme Court orders IDF to let residents return to terror Camps
articles.summary: The Supreme Court ordered the IDF to present a timetable for residents’ return to Jenin, Tulkarm, and Nur Shams camps despite stated security concerns.

articles.title: Pluralistic: Thwarted (09 Oct 2026) – Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary: Billionaireism is many things, but above all else, it is the power to do whatever *you* want to do, at the expense of whatever *other* people want to do.

articles.title: Mother's 3-day walk with sick daughter highlights Somalia's child malnutrition emergency
articles.summary: A Somali mother walked for three days carrying her severely malnourished 3-year-old daughter nearly 90 kilometers to a hospital in Kismayo
